note: Campground and canoe outfitter on the Sac River at Caplinger Mills, below Stockton Dam, with float trips, primitive and electric tent sites, two cabins and a yurt. The RV sites are in the woods; the operator's 'waterfront' RV sites sit 80-90 m of wooded bottomland back from the river. Water levels change with the dam's power-generation releases. Also listed as Caplinger Mills RV Park. --Claude
summary: Gate facts: posted $40 Sun-Thu / $45 Fri-Sat (operator page, 2026; Campspot agrees), well under $50; presence = working site + Campspot + phone; Google 4.6 (308). Confirmed 30/50-amp water/electric, no sewer; 23 RV sites; dump, store; season Mar 1 - Nov 1 (pages differ: 'November', 'Nov 1', 'October'); $7/extra person over 6 added. Operator's 'RV WATERFRONT' sites measure 80-90 m through woods to the Sac - not waterfront kept. Phone matches; pin at the store, fine.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: posted nightly rate $40 Sun-Thurs, $45 Fri-Sat for a 30/50-amp E/W RV site (operator's camping page, 2026), plus Campspot's $3.50 campground fee once per stay - under $50, so no gateway needed. Presence: working operator site (caplingerwoods.us) with phone (417) 276-3838 and Campspot booking. Google Maps: 4.6 stars, 308 reviews (phone matches). No Good Sam / Passport America / military claim on the operator pages. No weekly, monthly or seasonal sites are marketed anywhere on the site, so the long-stay tests don't apply. Campspot on 2026-10-13 showed every RV site free on the sample nights (9/9 waterfront, 10/10 standard), so nightly sites are sold to the public separately from float trips.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the operator calls its riverside sites 'RV WATERFRONT SITE NO SEWER' on Campspot (9 sites) and says the 23 RV sites have 'beautiful river views'. That's a contrary operator claim, so it's a re-audit lead. Measured on 0.18-0.2 m/px leaf-off frames, RV sites 1-8 (the map's river row, back-in spurs off the east road south of the yurt) end ~80-90 m from the Sac River's edge, with continuous wooded bottomland and a slough between. Sites 11-12 north of the cabins are ~65-70 m through trees; the open sandy ground at the water is the boat ramp area. Sac River here ~40 m wide. No open apron, and at most a leaf-off glimpse. Not waterfront kept.
ADDRESS: the operator site gives 6820 S 1451 Rd, Stockton; Google Maps and the old note give 6647 S 1451 Rd. The street address has been dropped from the note.

RV SITES vs Campspot: the operator says 23 RV sites. Campspot sells 19 (9 'waterfront', 10 standard, max lengths listed 63-90 ft) plus 4 'PRIMITVE CAMPSITE (CREEKSIDE NEAR PARKING LOT)' typed rv with max 20 ft (too short for EKKO).
MINIMUM: the 2-night minimum Campspot showed applies to the cabins only, not RV sites.
PIN: stored 37.7959,-93.8044 is Google's point at the store/entrance; the RV sites centre is ~140 m NE (about 37.7968,-93.8033) - within tolerance, optional move.
